Good Morning Mr. Sultan,

I hope you are doing well.

We would like to kindly inform you that the payment must be completed before your arrival to secure and confirm your booking.

As today is your scheduled arrival date and the booking is still unconfirmed due to the pending payment, please note that the booking may be automatically cancelled after 3:00 PM if the payment has not been received.

We kindly request you to complete the payment at your earliest convenience to avoid any cancellation.

Thank you for your cooperation and understanding.
